correctness.rationale: For n>=5, under literal b(i)=i+1 modulo n and a(1)=2,a(2)=3,a(i)=i (i>=3), B=a²b^(n-2) sends [1,n] to [1,n-2], and [1,m] to [1,m-2] for m>=4. With r=floor((n-2)/2), B^r reaches [1,2] (even n) or [1,3] (odd n), and a² sends either to singleton {3}. I independently replayed n=5,6,7,8,20 from the literal tables; verifier artifact enumerates full power automata only n<=12, not a universal certificate. Boundaries n=4 excluded from strict violation.
